title: ProjectCreateRequested
description: Someone asked to create or update a HOTL project under an organization (ADR 0024, ADR 0025): the orchestrator proposes it in the review service and asks an architect in a rule brief. Topic hotl.intent; subject and key: the request id, for example PRJ-0001. Producer: Intake. Main consumers: Orchestrator.

document.description: The proposed project record (JSON, per documents/project.schema.json).
